items.title: Mine Games
items.reason: A group of friends exploring an abandoned mine discover their own corpses and realize apparently minor events around the cabin and mine are parts of a repeating causal loop. Their attempts to understand and break the cycle progressively connect earlier warnings, future deaths, Michael's behavior and the loop itself. The film sustains a real time/reality puzzle across much of its runtime, although its explanation of why the cycle exists remains limited, so revelation cadence and progressive revelation are only moderate rather than top-tier.
